decisions.decision: Replaced black+isort+flake8 with ruff for linting and formatting.
decisions.reason: 50-100x faster pre-commit. Single tool replaces 3. Same rules via ruff.toml.

decisions.decision: Replaced numpy.fft with scipy.fft in 4 audio analysis modules.
decisions.reason: 2-4x faster FFT. scipy is drop-in compatible (same ndarray output). Already a transitive dependency.

decisions.decision: Added mutagen-rs as primary metadata backend with mutagen fallback.
decisions.reason: 100-300x faster metadata ops. Rust-based, API-compatible. Has cp313-win_amd64 wheel. Fallback ensures zero-risk.

decisions.reason: mcp-code-checker only exists as unpublished GitHub repo. Dippy is real AST-based bash auto-approve hook, installed as global PreToolUse hook.
